page.layout: One printed page (right of the scan) with a running head at the top and the main text in one column; a small fragment of the facing page lies at the far left edge (margin text, partly cut off). Below the text: a catchword "Vnde" at the right and a signature-like mark "Q" at the centre-left.

main_text.p: Significatio erat, fideles diaboli morsu in aeternum morituros peccata confitentes: ex fidei in Christum cruci affixum intuitu, sanitatem ad vitam aeternam recipere. Num. 21.5.6.7.8.9. Ioa. 3.14.15. & 12.32.
main_text.head: LIBER SEPTIMVS. De politeia diuina ecclesiastica. cap. I.

p.i: Atq; haec de politeia quatenus familia conformata erat: Sequitur de ecclesiastica politeia diuina.

main_text.p: Ecclesiastica politeia, est politeia diuina, quatenus ad particulares ecclesias, coniunctim, & seperatim regendas, sit instituta a Christo. Leu. 4. 13.14.15.21. & 8.4.35. & 9.1. Num. 5.6.7.41.45. 2. Cro. 13.9.11.12. & 19.5.8.11. & 30.23. Hhezr. 10.8. Psal. 89.6.8. 107.32. Mat. 18.16.17.18. Act. 6.1.2.3. & 11.29.30. & 14.23. & 15.22. & 20.17. 1. Cor. 5.13. & 11.2.3. & 12.27.28. cum Eph. 4.11. & 14.33.34. 1. Tim. 3.15. Tit. 1.1.2.3. Iam. 5.14. 1. Pet. 5.1.

Ecclesia particularis, est is coetus particularis fidem profitentium, qui ad omnia, saltem ordinaria diuinae politeias munera obeunda, idonie constitui & secerni possunt. 1. Sam. 10.5. Psal. 78.8. & 107.32. & 111.1. Esa. 4.4. & 62.8. Luc. 5.17. Math. 4.23. & 18.17. Act. 14.23. & 20.17. Rom. 12.4.5.6.7.8. 1. Cor. 4.17. & 14.33.34. & 16.1. 1. Tim. 3.15. Phil. 1.2. Tit. 1.2.3.4. 5.1. 1. Pet. 4.11. & 5.1. Iam. 5.14. Apoc. 1.20. & 2.1.

page.notes: Left-edge fragment of the facing page is cut off and illegible. Catchword and mark at the foot read as printed. Some reference numerals are doubtful in the scan (e.g., "Hhezr", "Tim.") and copied as printed.
